title: ICEP: Fix overflow UB
description:
The ICE Protocol uses signed integers for naturally unsigned values
like packet length; if negative values, which are impossible, are
rejected, that prevents the overflow.

Remove an if (tree) that results in some double-fetching.

Add a link to a URL describing the protocol.
